keyVerseDR: "All things therefore whatsoever you would that men should do to you, do you also to them." (Mt 7:12)

level1.title: This Week's Catholic Virtue: Fairness
level1.story: Fairness means treating everyone the same good way, not just the people we like.
level1.keyLine: I treat others the way I want to be treated.
level1.heartIntro: Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice fairness all week. On Saturday, talk together, write what you practiced, and a parent signs.
questions: When did we treat someone fairly this week?
How can we include everyone at school or church?
actions: Hang this sheet on the fridge
level1.prayer: Jesus, help me treat everyone fairly, the way I want to be treated. Amen.

activity.title: Daily Action Checklist
activity.intro: Color a star each day, Monday through Saturday. Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice with your family. A parent signs at the end of the week.
items: MON: Take turns in a game
WED: Let someone else go first
THU: Play with someone you don't usually play with
FRI: Follow the rules even when losing
SAT: Listen to both sides of a story

level2.title: This Week's Catholic Virtue: Fairness
level2.story: Fairness means treating everyone justly and equally, not deciding things only by our private feelings. A fair person gives everyone a turn, follows the rules, and does not play favorites. Jesus gave us the Golden Rule: treat others the way you want to be treated. Every person is made in God's image, so every person deserves to be treated fairly.
level2.keyLine: I treat others the way I want to be treated.
level2.heartIntro: Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice fairness all week. On Saturday, talk together, write what you practiced, and a parent signs.
questions: When did we treat someone fairly this week?
How did God help us grow in fairness?
actions: Hang this sheet on the fridge
level2.prayer: Jesus, help me treat everyone fairly, the way I want to be treated. Amen.

activity.title: Daily Action Checklist
activity.intro: Color a star each day, Monday through Saturday. Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice with your family. A parent signs at the end of the week.
items: MON: Divide a task fairly with a sibling
TUE: Include everyone in a group game
WED: Be fair to someone you don't like
THU: Admit when the other side is right
FRI: Stand up for someone treated unfairly
SAT: Pray for people who suffer injustice
